title: AI Cold Email & Lead Generation System, End to End
summary: Finds and enriches leads, researches each company, writes personalised emails, enrolls prospects in email campaigns, manages follow-ups and sends campaign reports.
headline: Cold email on autopilot, from lead to report
problem: Outbound sales meant a lot of manual work: finding prospects, researching them, writing emails, loading campaigns and chasing replies.
solution: I built the whole outbound pipeline in n8n. Leads are discovered and enriched through Apollo, each company is researched, Claude writes a personalised email, and prospects are enrolled in Instantly campaigns. Leads are then categorised by behaviour (opened, clicked, ignored) so follow-ups match what they did, and a report is generated for each campaign.
highlights: Lead discovery and enrichment from Apollo.io
Company research from the prospect's website
Behaviour-based follow-ups: clicked, opened, not opened
Campaign reports by email, plus WordPress REST API integration
role: Sole engineer. I designed the system, built every workflow, wrote the prompts and connected Apollo, Claude, Google Sheets, WordPress and Instantly.

results.label: Complete outbound workflow automated, from lead to report
Each email personalised from real company research
Follow-ups chosen by how each lead behaved
